The draws every lens returns

Source: R/lens.R
quorum_draws.Rd

A quorum_draws object is the one shape a lens hands to the comparison. For kind = "parameters" the draws are a named list of numeric vectors, one per estimand component, named with the hub's canonical parameter names. For kind = "response_curve" the draws are a numeric matrix with one row per draw and one column per grid point, and grid carries the candidate grid (for example nitrogen rates).

Usage

quorum_draws(
  draws,
  kind = "parameters",
  grid = NULL,
  source = "unknown",
  diagnostics = list()
)

Arguments

draws

Named list of numeric vectors, or a numeric matrix.

kind

One of "parameters" or "response_curve".

grid

Numeric grid for a response curve, else NULL.

source

Single string naming where the draws came from.

diagnostics

List of the producing lens's own diagnostics.

Value

A quorum_draws S7 object.
